_about: Query #4, lightning or cyclone alerts (backend/dhruva/answers/thunder.py). Thunderstorms are a forecast, never observed lightning: there is no lightning feed. Indic lines are machine translations and need a native speaker's check. Hand-corrected 2026-10-03: 'Depression' came back as the mental-health word in all four languages (ta, ml, hi, or); all four languages now use IMD's meteorological terms for Depression and Deep Depression (the Odia term needs a native speaker's confirmation). Article 'एक'/'ଏକ' (also the number one) removed 2026-10-03 so the number check reads no number the evidence lacks: hi.cyclone_read_bulletin, hi.caveat, or.cyclone_read_bulletin, or.caveat.
